newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's CGE wins China water deal.
newsitem.headline: France's CGE wins China water deal.

text.p: Compagnie Generale des Eaux said that the city of Tianjin, southeast of Beijing, had selected its CGE Tianjin unit to run a water purification plant in a 20-year deal.
The 500,000 cubic metres per day plant is one of the biggest of the city and provides water to a thrid of the population.
Generale des Eaux has a 55 percent stake in CGE Tianjin with Tianjin Waterworks having the remainder.
Generale said the plant would need an investment of $30 million dollars and had annual sales of $18 million.
